summary: Tested shift history page, reports CSV export, auth refresh, and not-authenticated bug fix. Found and fixed 2 critical issues: (1) duplicate 'endShift' declaration in AdminPOS.js causing compile failure; (2) infinite redirect loop on /login caused by axios interceptor attempting refresh on /auth/me 401 responses.

issues: Shift logs without salesperson_name show blank name row — from backend test data created during this iteration, not a production issue

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: AdminPOS.js had duplicate const endShift declaration (lines 111 and 149). Removed duplicate at line 149.
FIXED: api.js interceptor caused infinite redirect loop — added /auth/me to isRefreshOrLogin exclusion list so 401 from auth check doesn't trigger refresh→redirect→loop cycle.
NOTE: shift-end API in backend doesn't require valid salesperson ID — it just stores whatever salesperson_id/name is passed. Minor: could validate the ID.

rca_of_issues.infinite_login_redirect: api.js interceptor catches 401 from ANY endpoint except /auth/refresh and /auth/login. When unauthenticated browser loads /login, useAuth calls GET /auth/me → 401 → interceptor tries POST /auth/refresh → refresh fails (no session) → window.location.href='/login' → cycle repeats. Fix: added /auth/me to exclusion list so its 401 is treated as 'not logged in' rather than 'session expired'.
rca_of_issues.duplicate_endShift: Main agent added a second endShift function body at line 149 while the first already existed at line 111. Both identical — duplicate removed.
